explore-series.title: Tune a series circuit
explore-series.prompt: Turn the signal frequency until the series circuit is at resonance.
hints: Watch for the dip in impedance.
explore-series.success: At 7.1 MHz XL = XC: impedance drops to just the 2 Ω of resistance, so current is greatest.

explore-parallel.title: Tune a parallel circuit
explore-parallel.prompt: Now find resonance in the parallel circuit.
explore-parallel.success: Same 7.1 MHz, but now the impedance peaks: a parallel tuned circuit is high impedance at resonance.
